summary: Iteration 10: Tested Top-Deals API/page and 4 new club squads (Liverpool, Arsenal, Chelsea, Barcelona) with Wikimedia player images. All 9 pytest backend tests pass. Frontend UI verified via Playwright on /top-deals and /verein/{liverpool,arsenal,chelsea,barcelona}. All 3 features work correctly.

minor.issue: Duplicate 'Mohamed Salah' returned in Liverpool squad (appears twice: 20 entries, only 19 unique players).

action_items: Optional: Deduplicate the Liverpool squad - 'Mohamed Salah' is present twice in players collection for Liverpool club_id (frontend displays 20 rows but 19 unique). Consider a unique index on (name, current_club_id) or clean the seed.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend uses `player.image` (correct) matching API schema; ensure future refactors don't change to image_url without migration.
server.py is 2841 lines - should be split into modular routers (clubs, players, transfers, landing).
GET /api/players endpoint has no pagination metadata (total count); consider adding for large squads.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_transfers_and_squads.py cover Top-Deals sort/top-entries and 4 club squads (min 18 players each) + Wikimedia images. Top-Deals API returns 18 transfers sorted desc by fee_amount. Frontend top-deals page shows Gesamtvolumen=1311 Mio.€, Durchschnitt=72.8 Mio.€. Club squads have Kader tab showing all players with images and market values. Only known issue: duplicate Salah in Liverpool squad.
rca_of_the_issue: Duplicate Salah in Liverpool: two separate MongoDB documents in players collection have name='Mohamed Salah' with the same current_club_id. Likely from seeding twice or two players with same alias. Fix: clean up duplicates and add unique index (slug, current_club_id) or (name, current_club_id) in players collection.
